sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are persons with clean antecedent and petitioner no. 1 is a woman and have been falsely implicated in the present case, it is also submitted that from perusal of Sunita Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99587827/
